name: SetDropDownListValue
label: Select Option from Drop-Down or List
description: Selects an option from a drop-down or list UI element by specifying the option's visible name or its zero-based index.

fields.name: IdentificationObjectPath
fields.label: Drop-Down or List UI Element
fields.description: The UI element representing the drop-down or list from which you want to select an option.

fields.name: OptionToSelect
fields.label: Option to Select (Name or Index)
fields.description: Specify the option to select by its visible name or by its zero-based index (e.g., 0 for the first item).

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Maximum Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: The maximum number of seconds to wait for the drop-down or list element to appear.

fields.name: IsOptionSelected
fields.label: Was Option Selected?
fields.description: Outputs true if the option was selected successfully, otherwise false.
